name: Complete the real Government Plaza prerequisite civic in the captured game

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert(p.stage=='NEEDS_DOMAIN_LAW' and p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1,'normal Government Plaza Civic prerequisite changed'); b.Queue('PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC'); return 'official Civic research queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' or a=='UNKNOWN_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' or a=='REJECTED_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC' or a=='PENDING_PREPARE_DISTRICT_CIVIC'
local a=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC_ATTEMPT'); local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return a and p and p:IsTurnActive() and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()==a.turn+1

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; b.Queue('RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'); return 'read-only native Civic recheck queued after one real turn'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='UNKNOWN_RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='REJECTED_RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' or a=='PENDING_RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ'

steps.code: local p=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); local a=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC_ATTEMPT')); local c=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC_RECEIPT')); local d=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ')); local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_CIVIC')); local b=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_FIXTURE_BARRIER')); assert(p.districtCivicOwned and p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1 and a.owner==0 and a.index==GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_DOMAIN_LAW'].Index and a.sequence==a.token and c.phase=='SETTER_RETURNED' and c.token==a.token and c.turn==a.turn and c.beforeSpent==a.beforeSpent and d.action=='RESUME_CAPACITY_CIVIC_READ' and d.status=='OBSERVED' and d.owned and d.originalToken==a.token and d.originalTurn==a.turn and d.turn==a.turn+1 and d.frame>0 and r.owner==a.owner and r.index==a.index and r.originalToken==a.token and r.originalSequence==a.sequence and r.commandTurn==a.turn and r.turn==d.turn and r.token==d.token and r.readSerial==d.serial and r.readFrame==d.frame and r.readPublishEpoch==d.publishEpoch and r.beforeSpent==a.beforeSpent and r.afterSpent==r.beforeSpent and b.phase=='RESUME_READ' and b.token==r.token and b.turn==d.turn and b.serial>=2,'real-turn Civic, read-only Gameplay/UI proof, or official title accounting differs'); return p.stage

local d=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission and d.mission.turn==23 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1 and d.captive and d.captive.captor==1 and d.captive.nameIndex==-1,'original native captive or mission history changed after the real turn'); return 'original captive remains'
